content.title: Trump continues to target Robert Mueller after his death - The Washington Post
content.text: Democracy Dies in DarknessBy Emily DaviesPresident Donald Trump on Saturday cheered the death of Robert S. Mueller III, a towering figure in federal law enforcement whom the president viewed as a leading antagonist and the face of efforts to undermine his presidency.
